name: BeamDrop
highlights: 📓 BeamDrop Smart Notebook: Text, code, and links open directly into an interactive notebook on Phone & PC
⚡ Zero-Latency Instant Beaming: Scan and view without waiting for WebRTC connection or download confirmation
💻 Syntax Highlighting & Line Numbers: Auto-detects JavaScript, Python, HTML, SQL, and Shell code
🔗 Smart URL Web Cards: 1-click browser launcher and native mobile share integration
✨ Ultra-Clean Cyber Glassmorphism UI: Fully refined premium interface for the Chrome Extension
🛡️ 100% Simulator-Free Engine: Clean, fast, and frozen-free OTA update system

changelog.title: Smart Notebook Engine & Ultra-Clean Glassmorphism UI
changes: Dedicated BeamDrop Notebook web app (/notebook.html) for zero-latency note and code viewing on mobile & desktop
Instant hash-embedded QR code: short text, code, and links beam with 0ms waiting time without WebRTC handshake
Built-in Code Engine with syntax highlighting, line numbers, language badges, and file exporting (.js, .py, .html, .txt)
Smart URL cards with 1-tap browser opener and mobile native share (Web Share API)
Fully overhauled extension styling: ultra-clean obsidian dark glassmorphism theme
Completely purged test simulator for smooth, frozen-free performance

changelog.title: Automated Package Downloader & Dual GitHub/Vercel Sync
changes: Direct chrome.downloads API integration: downloads new extension.zip directly to user Downloads folder with 1 click
Dual-cloud polling: Checks Vercel + raw.githubusercontent.com simultaneously with cache-busting
Native Chrome desktop notification when a new version is pushed to GitHub/Vercel
Cleaned up Updates tab for a pure, clean, fast OTA update experience
Guided 2-step reload assistant with 1-click chrome://extensions launcher

changelog.title: 1-Click Fast Updater & Background Notification Engine
changes: In-extension fast updater interface: update directly without removing or re-adding the extension in Chrome
Toolbar notification badge ('NEW') when a new GitHub/Vercel release is published
Periodic background watcher to alert users automatically of new releases
Integrated TURN relay for high-speed transfer across firewalls

changelog.title: Direct Download Gateway & Isolated Download Portal
changes: Direct Phone Download: Scanning QR immediately prompts native browser download for that specific file
Dedicated isolated download window with zero website distraction
Direct stream progress bar with live MB/s and instant auto-download trigger

changelog.title: Staging Area & Flow Control
changes: Multi-file staging container before generating QR code
64KB chunk backpressure control to prevent buffer saturation
Offline pure CSS styling & strict 380px sizing

changelog.title: Initial Manifest V3 Launch
changes: Manifest V3 Chrome Extension architecture
Direct Device-to-Device WebRTC DataChannel transfer
Zero cloud storage and zero database
